welcome.headline: Early COPD signals from your patients’ voice
welcome.body: A small recording. A clearer picture. Bring remote respiratory monitoring into your everyday practice, with you in control.

trend.title: Voice risk score
trend.note: Illustrative · no patient data · not a diagnosis

welcome.extra: An extra signal, not a diagnosis
welcome.footer: SpiroAI · Professional voice screening support · Fictional demonstration, not clinically validated.

common.footer: SpiroAI · Professional voice screening support · Fictional demonstration, not clinically validated.
common.sampleNotice: Fictional sample data · AI model, example ranges and thresholds are clinically unvalidated. Screening support, not a diagnosis. Doctor has final judgment.

howItWorks.title: A voice recording becomes a clinical conversation
howItWorks.subtitle: How SpiroAI supports your workflow

steps.title: Invite & get consent
steps.body: Your patient joins the mobile app and controls their consent.

steps.title: Record & screen
steps.body: A sustained /a/ and short reading are analyzed by a separate AI model.

steps.title: Review & decide
steps.body: Inspect risk, confidence, quality and trends. You choose the next step.

howItWorks.confidence: AI confidence: Shown with every result
howItWorks.judgment: Final judgment: Always the treating doctor
howItWorks.note: Static modal companion to S01 · No actual patient data is shown before login. Saved sessions skip welcome and return to Dashboard.

intro.title: Better monitoring starts with trust
intro.body: Join a workspace built for licensed healthcare professionals. Your identity helps protect every patient you care for.
intro.saved: Progress saved on this device. Back and Next keep your entries.

account.title: Create your professional account
account.name: Full name *
account.emailHint: Use the email you check at your practice.
strength: Strong · 12+ characters, mixed letters, numbers and symbols

professional.title: Your professional details
professional.licenseHint: We verify your license to protect patients and restrict clinical access.
professional.alertTitle: Your clinical access stays restricted until verified
professional.alertBody: Automatic registry checks may be followed by a manual review.

terms.title: Review and give your agreement
terms.alertBody: SpiroAI supports screening. It does not diagnose COPD or replace spirometry and your clinical assessment.
terms.tos: I accept the professional Terms of Service.
terms.dpa: I agree to the data processing agreement for health information.
terms.medical: I understand the medical disclaimer and retain final clinical responsibility.

pending.title: Your application is in good hands
pending.subtitle: We’re checking your professional license. Usually under 24 hours.

upload.title: Help us verify faster
upload.body: Optional license photo · JPG, PNG or PDF · Up to 10 MB

pending.notify: We’ll send an email and push update when your status changes.

explore.title: Explore while you wait
explore.subtitle: READ-ONLY DEMO · Fictional patient, no clinical actions
explore.profileBody: Sample voice recording and a personal baseline
explore.final: Final judgment: Demo only · no care decisions

login.title: Back to the people in your care
login.intro: A secure workspace for a more connected picture of respiratory health.
login.sharedBody: For your patients’ privacy, inactive sessions automatically log out.
login.subtitle: Log in to your professional workspace
login.encrypted: Your connection is encrypted. Two-factor verification follows.
login.invalid: Check your email and password and try again.
login.demo: Demo access: any email and a password of 8+ characters. Fictional data only.

twofa.title: One more step to keep care secure
twofa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twofa.subtitleSms: Enter the 6-digit code we sent by SMS.
twofa.trustNote: Only trust a device that is not shared with other staff.
twofa.useSms: Use SMS instead · Send code to ••• ••• 0138
twofa.expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
twofa.wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.subtitle: We’ll send a secure reset link to your email.
reset.sentTitle: If an account exists, a reset link is on its way
reset.sentBody: Check your inbox and spam folder. The link expires in 30 minutes.
reset.note: Companion to S04 · The confirmation never reveals whether an email is registered.

biometric.title: Welcome back, Elena
biometric.body: Use this tablet’s biometric authentication to unlock your professional workspace.
biometric.alertTitle: A trusted device, not a shared device
biometric.alertBody: Biometrics are optional. A password and 2FA remain available.
biometric.unavailable: Biometrics are not available on this device
biometric.unavailableBody: Use your password and two-factor code instead.
biometric.note: Static tablet adaptation · Biometric availability depends on the device. Session timeout still applies.

states.recorded: State change is recorded where applicable.

states.verifiedBody: Welcome email sent. Your first-time dashboard tour is ready.
states.pendingBody: Usually under 24 hours. We’ll email and push status changes.

states.moreBody: Please upload a clearer photo of your license, including its expiry date.
states.tooManyBody: Login temporarily locked for 15 minutes. Security email sent.
states.expiredBody: Log in again to return to the result you were reviewing.
states.sampleFooter: Fictional sample data · Clinical examples are unvalidated · Every result retains confidence, recording quality, the screening disclaimer and the doctor’s final judgment.
